rows.commentary: 5.5: Mohit Ulva hits the good length, extracting late sideways movement that forces Niraj Kumar Yadav into a defensive prod and beats the outside edge completely.
5.6: Mohit Ulva tosses it up outside off, inviting Niraj Kumar Yadav to loft it cleanly over extra cover for four.
6.1: Ishan Sood angles it in from a good length, leaving Nischal Chhetri to steer it tentatively into the leg side.
6.2: Ishan Sood generates late away-movement from a probing length to befuddle Nischal Chhetri's defensive prod.
6.3: Ishan Sood forces another frustrated slash past the bat as Nischal Chhetri searches helplessly for the line.
6.4: Ishan Sood finds the outside edge yet again as Nischal Chhetri fishing forward is beaten comprehensively.
6.5: Ishan Sood tests the front foot, finding Nischal Chhetri ready to dead-bat it toward cover.
6.6: Ishan Sood completes a maiden as Nischal Chhetri edges a short-of-a-length delivery safely in front of cover.
7.1: Kavya Patel zips one in from short of a length, prompting a back-foot defensive block from Niraj Kumar Yadav.
7.2: Kavya Patel extracts an edge-like sound past off stump as Niraj Kumar Yadav drives without consequence.
7.3: Kavya Patel hoists his hands in utter disbelief as Niraj Kumar Yadav survives a screaming full incoming delivery that narrowly slips past leg stump.
7.4: Kavya Patel probes forward as Niraj Kumar Yadav dead-bats it firmly into the turf.
7.5: Kavya Patel targets the crease from a short of a good length, nipping back sharply to thud high into Niraj Kumar Yadav's pads, comfortably clearing the timber.
7.6: Niraj Kumar Yadav looks to dead-bat the delivery, only to drag an inside edge directly back into his own pads.
8.1: Ishan Sood lands it on a probing good length, extracting away-movement that completely leaves Nischal Chhetri clutching at thin air on the outside edge.
8.2: Ishan Sood pushes the ball fuller to attack the stumps, but Nischal Chhetri steps forward with a straight bat to block it firmly.
8.3: Ishan Sood claims his third wicket as Nischal Chhetri flashes without footwork, slicing a drive straight to Yashveer Goud at cover who safely pouches the catch with both hands.
17.5: Manal Chauhan skids through with a quicker delivery, trapping Niraj Kumar Yadav plumb in front as the sweep shot fails entirely.
17.6: Manal Chauhan delivers a flat length ball that Aashish Luhar steers wide of slip, collecting two runs as short third man gives chase.
18.1: Ishan Sood pitches on a good length around off, allowing Darsh Sonar to softly ease it through the covers for a single.
18.2: Ishan Sood fires it full from wide of the crease, inducing a flat-footed push from Aashish Luhar that flashes past the outside edge.
18.3: Ishan Sood finds the away seam once more, leaving Aashish Luhar completely beaten on another tentative forward prod.
18.4: Ishan Sood attacks the pads with a straighter full ball, clipping Aashish Luhar but sliding harmlessly down the leg side past the umpire's gaze.
18.5: Ishan Sood clutches his head in disbelief as another devastatingly full delivery slips past Aashish Luhar's flashing drive by a coat of paint.
18.6: Ishan Sood relentlessly targets the fourth-stump channel from wide on the crease, straightening one more to beat Aashish Luhar's outside edge.
19.1: Manal Chauhan serves up a full delivery on the stumps, neatly clipped away through midwicket by Darsh Sonar for a single.
19.2: Manal Chauhan drifts onto the pads, drawing an inside edge from Aashish Luhar down toward short fine leg.
19.3: Manal Chauhan attacks middle and leg on a length, solidly defended from the front foot by Aashish Luhar.
19.4: Manal Chauhan tosses up an overpitched flighted delivery, and Aashish Luhar lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a much-needed boundary.
19.5: Manal Chauhan fires it full into the stumps, and Aashish Luhar meets it with a straight, defensive bat.
19.6: Manal Chauhan drops it full once more, and Aashish Luhar lofts it tentatively over the bowler's head for a single as long-off mops it up.
20.1: Ishan Sood finds the groove outside off, extracting seam movement that leaves Aashish Luhar chasing air on the drive.
20.2: Ishan Sood targets off-middle with a probing length delivery, prompting a watchful defensive block from the crease by Aashish Luhar.
20.3: Ishan Sood attacks from wide of the crease on a length, and Aashish Luhar nudges it safely into the off side.
20.4: Ishan Sood extracts sharp away-movement from a full and wide delivery, inducing yet another frustrated drive and a miss from Aashish Luhar.
32.3: Arjun Rajput slides it flatter into the stumps, and Darsh Sonar retreats to dead-bat it back to the bowler.
32.4: Arjun Rajput drifts one slower through the air, inducing a soft chipped return that narrowly eludes the bowler's grasp.
32.5: Arjun Rajput offers width outside, allowing Darsh Sonar to slap it cleanly away to sweeper cover for a single.
32.6: Arjun Rajput gets this one spinning in off a length, and Sachin Bhatt punches it straight back to the bowler.
33.1: Yashveer Goud tosses it up on middle, and the left-handed Darsh Sonar clips it firmly along the grass to mid-wicket.
33.2: Yashveer Goud fires it into the pads as Darsh Sonar drops low for a sweep, catching the thigh pad with the ball harmlessly sliding down leg.
33.3: Yashveer Goud feeds a fuller length, permitting Darsh Sonar to stroke it smoothly down to long-off for a single.
33.4: Yashveer Goud floats one around off stump, drawing Sachin Bhatt forward to push it into the off side.
33.5: Yashveer Goud fires this one straight into the pads, Sachin Bhatt attempts to tuck it leg-side but manages only a leading edge that dies safely in the turf ahead of the bowler.
33.6: Yashveer Goud spears it wide outside off, but Sachin Bhatt misses out on the width by picking out the fielder at point with a cut.
34.1: Arjun Rajput skids one in with the arm, beating the left-hander as he attempts to tuck it into the leg side.
34.2: Arjun Rajput tosses it up around off, and Darsh Sonar drives firmly straight to the fielder stationed at cover.
34.3: Arjun Rajput drifts it up invitingly, and Darsh Sonar simply nudges it straight back to the bowler's hands.
34.4: Arjun Rajput floats one onto the leg stump, allowing Darsh Sonar to drop to one knee and sweep it firmly toward deep backward square leg for a brace.
34.5: Arjun Rajput offers a tempting floater outside the off stump, which Darsh Sonar meets with a stinging drive straight to cover.
34.6: Arjun Rajput fires it through with real pace, forcing the left-handed Darsh Sonar onto the back foot where an inside edge saves him and dribbles into the leg side for a single.
35.1: Yashveer Goud tosses it up generously on off stump, prompting Darsh Sonar to stride forward and wrist it straight back down the pitch.
35.2: Yashveer Goud flattens his trajectory slightly, and Darsh Sonar defends solidly behind the line of the stumps right back to the bowler.
35.3: Yashveer Goud floats the delivery closely around off stump, with Darsh Sonar leaning across to work it neatly toward mid-wicket.
35.4: No run for Darsh Sonar off Yashveer Goud.
1.1: Nitesh Patel finds late inward movement, catching the thick inside edge as Aaryavir Sehwag drives forward to collect a single at deep backward square-leg.
1.2: Nitesh Patel drops it full on middle stump, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani presents a straight bat to push the delivery solidly toward mid-off.
1.3: Nitesh Patel serves it full outside off, allowing Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani to lean into a sublime cover-drive that races away past cover and mid-off.
1.4: Nitesh Patel strays miles outside the tramlines, prompting an easy wide call as Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani calmly leaves the ball alone.
1.4: Nitesh Patel targets the channel back of a length, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani retreats onto his back foot to shoulder arms.
1.5: Nitesh Patel digs it in short of a length on off, met by a back-foot defense from Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani that initiates a sharp single toward mid-on.
1.6: Nitesh Patel angles one back sharply from a shortish length, forcing Aaryavir Sehwag down the track to bunt it safely back.
2.1: Sushil Rawal pitches it full and wide outside off, leaving the right-hander to watch it slip past into the keeper's gloves.
2.2: Sushil Rawal lands it on a length outside the off stump, the ball biting away from Lakshya Raichandani who watches it sail through to the keeper.
2.3: Sushil Rawal extracts extra away-movement as Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani drives tentatively, the ball whistling agonizingly past the outside edge.
2.4: Sushil Rawal bowls full on off and middle to a wandering Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani, who glides it away with a graceful flick wide of mid-wicket for four.
2.5: Sushil Rawal drops short outside off, pulled away to square leg by Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani before a fielding fumble gifts them the single.
2.6: Sushil Rawal bowls a length delivery outside off to Aaryavir Sehwag, who walks forward and lets the ball go untouched.
3.1: Nitesh Patel delivers a short, rising ball outside off to Lakshya Raichandani, who lifts it off the back foot into backward point.
3.2: Nitesh Patel bowls a wide, back‑of‑length ball outside off to Lakshya Raichandani, who leaves it alone and the umpire calls it wide.
3.2: Nitesh Patel again to Lakshya Raichandani, a back‑of‑length outside off that Lakshya meets on the back foot, punching it with an open face to backward point.
3.3: Nitesh Patel’s short ball outside off to Lakshya Raichandani is cut wide of cover, but the timing is off and the ball stops inside the ropes for two runs.
3.4: No run for Lakshya Raichandani off Nitesh Patel.
16.1: Bipin Sharma angles a good-length delivery outside off, and Lakshya Raichandani moves back to punch it toward sweeper cover for a single that brings up his fifty.
16.2: Bipin Sharma tosses it full outside off, inviting Aaryavir Sehwag forward to punch it hard and straight down to long-off for one.
16.3: Bipin Sharma fires a full one wide outside off, and Lakshya Raichandani offers a rare leave to a game starved of such restraint.
16.4: Bipin Sharma slows it up and draws it full outside off, allowing Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani to stride forward and steer it out to sweeper cover.
16.5: Bipin Sharma keeps a quicker, good-length trajectory on middle stump, and Aaryavir Sehwag steps forward to nudge it toward mid-wicket.
16.6: Bipin Sharma darts it full into the leg stump, forcing Aaryavir Sehwag to clear room and lose his bottom hand as he drills it straight to the extra-cover ring fielder.
17.1: Sachin Bhatt drops it flat on a good length just outside off, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani rocks back to punch it firmly toward long-off.
17.2: Sachin Bhatt tosses up a full delivery on off stump, met with a balanced, forward-leaning defensive stroke from Aaryavir Sehwag toward extra-cover.
17.3: Sachin Bhatt floats it full outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag drops onto his back knee to launch it powerfully straight down the ground on one bounce for four.
17.4: Sachin Bhatt serves up a wide, low-staying full ball past Aaryavir Sehwag's drive, nutmegging Aashish Luhar to race away for four byes.
17.5: Sachin Bhatt delivers a flat, good-length ball outside off, prompting Aaryavir Sehwag to go onto the back foot and punch it cleanly to extra-cover.
17.6: Sachin Bhatt pitches it full outside off, where Aaryavir Sehwag miscues his lofted drive well short of the fielder, escaping what could have been a dismissal or maximum.

18.1: Bipin Sharma tosses it full outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag lunges forward, opening the blade to loft it cleanly over backward point where a diving effort from the sweeper proves futile as the ball races away for four.
18.2: Bipin Sharma dials back the pace on a good length outside off, allowing Aaryavir Sehwag to drop onto the back foot and punch it crisply to sweeper cover for a single.

18.3: Bipin Sharma floats up a full delivery that tempts Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani down the track to smash a hard drive, saved brilliantly by a sprawling left-handed dive from long-off that halts three potential runs.

18.4: Bipin Sharma serves up a half-volley on middle, which Aaryavir Sehwag meets on the front foot, drilling it straight past the bowler's boots in a flash before long-off and long-on can even blink for another boundary.
18.5: Bipin Sharma digs it short and wide outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag retreats onto the back foot, slicing a cut directly into the hands of the fielder stationed at backward point.
18.6: Bipin Sharma loops it full on leg-stump, prompting Aaryavir Sehwag to march down the track and carve out room to drive toward long-off, bringing the scores level.

19.1: Sachin Bhatt fires in a flat length ball that Aaryavir Sehwag steps down the pitch to knock toward long-on, sealing a resounding ten-wicket victory for India over Nepal amidst the warmth of post-match handshakes.

summary.text: In the NPLU19 innings, Darsh Sonar was the top scorer with 43 off 93 balls as the team reached 128-10, with Arjun Rajput taking 3 for 8. India U19 won by 10 wkts after finishing on 129-0 in their innings, led by top scorer Aaryavir Sehwag with 70 off 52 balls.
